verdicts.title: The projective dimension of sequentially Cohen-Macaulay monomial ideals

verdicts.title: Minimal generating sets of large powers of bivariate monomial ideals
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: It is known that for a monomial ideal $I$, the number of minimal generators, $μ(I^n)$, eventually follows a polynomial pattern for increasing $n$. In general, little is known about the power at which this pattern emerges. Even less is known about the exact form of the minimal generators after this power. verdicts.title: Support posets of some monomial ideals
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The support poset of a monomial ideal $I\subseteq\mathbf{k}[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ encodes the relation between the variables $x_1,\dots,x_n$ and the minimal monomial generators of $I$. It is known that not every poset is realizable as the support poset of some monomial ideal.
